BedPose.description:
Where the bed is, seen from the camera: the transform from the bed frame
to the camera's, `X_cam = R · X_bed + t`.

rotation_rodrigues.description: `R` as a Rodrigues vector, in radians.

calibrated_at.description: The date the frames were taken, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

frames.description: How many frames the marks were on.

rms_reprojection_px.description:
The RMS distance of the marks from their projected outlines, in
pixels.

Intrinsics.description:
The lens: focal lengths and principal point in pixels, and the fisheye
distortion terms `k1`–`k4`.

fx.description: Focal length along X, in pixels.

fy.description: Focal length along Y, in pixels.

k.description:
The equidistant model's `k1`–`k4`; the tool fits `k1` and writes the
rest as 0.

Landmark.description: A fixed chassis feature the drift check locates in every frame.

center_px.description: Where its patch's centre was in the calibrated frames, in pixels.

patch_png_base64.description: The grey patch around it, as a base64 PNG.

search_radius_px.description: How far from `center_px` it is searched for, in pixels.

Motion.description: How the printer moves its bed: the one motion a calibration describes.

oneOf.description: The bed moves only in Z, dropping as the print rises.

description: One printer's camera calibration, as `tools/camera-calibration` writes it.

alignment_max_offset_px.description: The first-layer alignment check's pass threshold, in pixels.

camera_snapshot_url.description:
The `[camera] snapshot_url` the calibrated frames came from; a frame
from any other is refused.

drift_tolerance_px.description:
How far, in pixels, two visible landmarks must both have moved for the
camera to count as moved.

image_size_px.description:
The calibrated frames' size, `[width, height]`; a frame of any other
size is refused, never scaled.

motion.description: How the printer moves its bed.

schema_version.description:
Always [`SCHEMA_VERSION`], which the generated schema pins, so the
calibration tool's tests refuse a file of any other version.

title: CameraCalibration
